```yaml
name: Lint, Typecheck, Test, Build, Publish Dry-Run, Audit

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-and-typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Check code formatting
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run tsc

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish dry-run
        run: |
          echo "Running npm publish --dry-run for all packages"
          find . -name package.json -not -path "./node_modules/*" -execdir sh -c 'echo "Dry-run publish in $(pwd)"; npm publish --dry-run' \;
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level high
```
